summary:
The bakery puts its gable end to the street on a narrow plan. The ground storey is dark deepslate brick with a shop window and fold-down counter on each side of the door. Above it, a white half-timbered storey framed in stripped spruce juts out over the street, under a steep slate roof with a flour-loft hoist beam at its peak. A lower cobbled-deepslate bakehouse wing on the east holds the brick oven, which bulges out at the back under a tall red chimney. Narrow gable-to-street Germanic bakery: dark deepslate ground storey, jettied stripped-spruce Fachwerk upper storey with white wool daub, steep slate roof, hoist beam, and a cobbled-deepslate bakehouse wing with a brick barrel-vault oven under a smoking chimney.
Written: elements.md (checklist with constructions), and PALETTE (ids checked), VOCABULARY (41 helpers), ROOMS (6 with boxes), PARTS (6) and Notes appended to plan.md.
Stairs rise north in the SW corner from the Backstube to the Stube; the attic is reached by a ladder, and the oven has a hollow flue for its two campfires.

Massing and shell: parts/shell.mjs builds the street and sidewalk, deepslate ground storey, three floors with stair/attic holes, stair housing, two partitions, jettied half-timber upper storey with Mann braces, gable frames, and the wing walls and gable. Openings and reserved cells are left unset; make.sh is clean for P1 and check shows nothing floating.

Wing gable y=6..7 daub may overlap the wing roof's stair cells; check once the wing roof exists.
Upper partition posts: x=9 post at z=14 y=7 is the stair fence instead of a post.
Massing and shell: still OFF-PALETTE: polished_blackstone_brick_stairs x64 (roof.json)

summary:

make.sh wrote a whole build.nbt: P3 placed 111, 0 refused, 0 off-palette; mcd check shows 0 floating/unsupported; zoom renders show the oven and chimney rising behind the wing with the top campfire lit.

The smoker at (18,2,21) sits inside the bakehouse room box [18,2,14,20,7,21]; the room-3 designer must keep that cell clear, and P1/P6 must not write it.

The chimney passes behind the wing (z=24..25), south of the wing roof's eave at z=23, so it never cuts through a roof. Confirmed by render; the plan's 'passes through the roof' wording does not apply here.

A front zoom render reads as the plan intends; the sign and hoist are too small in the views to confirm closely.
plan.md checklist and six elements.md items ticked; make.sh writes a whole build.nbt.

Mann braces at (7,8,8) and (15,8,8) face west and east (toward the nearest post on each panel's outer side); plan.md did not give facings, so this is my reading.
mcd check reports the hoisted barrel at (11,16,5) as an orphan. This is the intended hanging load on the chain, not a fault, but the check cannot be told to allow it.
The sign text 'Bäckerei' was passed to signArm but I did not verify it was written into the block entity; the zoom render is too small to read text.
The hoist beam and loft shutters at the apex are visible only as a small detail in the front views; not checked at close range.

Farmland under the wheat has no water block within 4 cells, so it will dry back to dirt; the plan has no water source and I did not add one off-spec.
The woodpile (x=7..10, z=24..25) sits across the back-door path at x=8; the walk goes around it via x=6 or x=11, so it is passable but the path is hidden under the stack.
The west gate (1,1,20) opens onto the lot edge at x=0, and the east gate (23,1,16) opens onto nothing (x=23 is the last lot column). Both match the plan's coordinates but read as gates to nowhere.
